louise carson.name: Louise Carson
louise carson.origin: Louise Carson accompanied her father on a jungle expedition that turned out to be a nightmare when they were attacked by the savage Monolink Tribe. The jungle hero Tigerman tried to rescue them. Despite the hero's efforts, they were captured and brought before the Monolink's ruler King Kuu who had them locked up, intending to use them as slaves to expand his kingdom. Tigerman and his ape ally Rangoo would break them free and they would escape in one of Kuu's ships. The ship was damaged in their escape and they were forced to abandon ship and swim the rest of the way. Louise rode on Tigerman's strong back, however her father drowned in the strong currents. Getting to safety, Louise insisted on staying with Tigerman. Their subsequent activities remain unrevealed.

louise spalding.name: Louise Spalding
louise spalding.origin: Little is know about Louise Spalding. She was described by her mother as being a fiery redhead with a strong will, free spirit, and a good head on her shoulders. She worked as a firefighter in or near Cooperstown, Alaska. She didn't show any desire to "settle down", but one day she was met by a strange man, secretly Enigma in his human form from the future. Enigma sought to impregnate Louise in order for her future daughter to fall under his control. Fortunately, Jean Grey, possessed by the Phoenix Force, also traveled back in time and intervened by banishing the Enigma. Using her Phoenix powers, Jean proceeded to impregnate Louise with their child, which Louise carried full term. Immediately after Louise gave birth her daughter manifested an active X-Gene, the first new manifestation since M-Day. In an attempt to kill the new mutant infant, the Purifiers killed everyone in the hospital including Louise. Luckily, Cable saved the child before the Purifiers were able to murder her. After Hope returned to the present, lost her father, and defeated Bastion, she expressed an interest in discovering her biological family in Alaska. Cyclops agreed to Hope's request and organized an escort team of Rogue, Dr. Nemesis, and Cypher. Once the group arrived in Alaska they discovered the identity of Louise Spalding, visited her grave, and Hope was able to meet her maternal grandmother, although she did not reveal her biological connection.

louise wharton.name: Louise Wharton
louise wharton.origin: thumb|left|150px|Original appearanceLouise was a Martian girl, whom Dr. Bryan Hoskins took as a newborn among the orphans of Mars to carry out an experiment where he would be able to transform a Martian into a perfect Earthling. Once she arrived on Earth, Hoskin performed a treatment on the newborn to change her skin pigmentation from green to Caucasian and then she was given up for adoption to an Earth family. Years later, having become a beautiful girl, completely unrecognizable as an alien, Louise became engaged to Stephen Dowell, an athletic champion, but another boy named Chip Ladby also had a crush on her, who also hated Stephen not only because he had taken Louise away from him but also for his athletic successes. During a check-up in Dr. Hoskins' office, Chip discovered, peeking into the doctor's archive, the document relating to Hoskins' experiment regarding raising a Martian child to become a perfect Earthling, and became convinced that the Martian was his rival in love, Stephen Dowell. Convinced that he could use the document to reveal Stephen's true nature, Dr. Hoskins asked him if he was sure that the Martian was Stephen since he himself was adopted. Scared by this, for fear that they would discover that he was an alien, Chip left town. Days later, Dr. Hoskins attended Stephen and Louise's wedding, and thought to himself about what Chip had discovered, but that in reality the Martian was Louise.

lourdes chantel.name: Lourdes Chantel
lourdes chantel.origin: Lourdes Chantel was a mutant teleporter from Barcelona and a member of high society. She met Sebastian Shaw shortly before his trip to Afghanistan and the two fell madly in love. In America, Shaw was invited to join the Hellfire Club, something which Lourdes did not support. She tried to sway Sebastian away from the Club and its leader, Ned Buckman, fearing it might corrupt her lover, but she wasn't successful. With time, Shaw grew close to Buckman and eventually rose to the rank of Black Bishop. Feeling confident in this position, he also proposed to Lourdes, but Lourdes had become afraid of Shaw and wanted out, something which she confided to Emma Frost. When Buckman betrayed Shaw by sending some Sentinels to hunt him and his allies, Emma saw an opportunity and made Shaw believe that Lourdes had died saving his life. This led Shaw to kill Buckman and take over the Hellfire Club. After the dust had settled, Emma met Lourdes and sent her to Wilson Fisk, so he could fix her with a new identity. Years later, Lourdes reappeared, being seen passing through one of Krakoa's Gateways, before facing one anti-mutant protester and reiterating her pride in being a mutant. She was made the new Black Queen of the Hellfire Trading Corporation, supplanting Sebastian Shaw. During the attack on the Hellfire Gala, she saved as many mutants as possible by teleporting them away, but during the process was shot and killed by an agent of Orchis. Later, she was one of the mutants resurrected by The Five to fight against Orchis.

lovecraft roxxon bio asset.name: Lovecraft (Roxxon Bio-Asset)
lovecraft roxxon bio asset.origin: Lovecraft was one of four monsters under Roxxon's control set loose in Phoenix, Arizona to draw out the Hulk. When the Hulk was deployed to the scene of Lovecraft's attack, the Route 60 interchange, he was accidentally teleported on top of the monster, causing him to be swallowed almost instantly. Due to the damage that he received from the parasitic organisms within Lovecraft's stomach, the Hulk switched to his child-like "Savage Hulk" persona. He tore through the monster's stomach, killing it, but also inadvertently unleashing the smaller monsters on the bystanders at the scene, who were then restrained by Roxxon's ally, Xemnu the Living Titan.

low key.name: Low Key
low key.origin: Lowkey, Low Key or Low-key was a super-villain and the Mighty Sore's evil third cousin twice removed on his mother's side—along with Sore's main antagonist. The Watchman briefly considered offering Lowkey to become the villain behind a new Secret War crossover to counteract the Demeaning Cosmos' Legendary Crisis of the Infinite Millenium; however, the Watchman finally decided to call other villains. Having little to do, and having trouble to get the poses that Kirby-homaging artists asked for, Low Key staged a scheme out of spite, to trouble all the superheroes on Earth. During this "Smacks of Vengeance," Low Key recruited villains from the Dee-See universe (Jokester, Magilla Grod, Metal-toe, Sinestronie), who were similarly disgusted at home for their own reasons (The Dee-See heroes were becoming so violent that the villains' usual deeds were below the so-called heroic deeds). During an unannounced cross-company cross-over, the villains attacked the Marble heroes, with some of them (Scaredevil and Chaplin America specially) tried to discover how and why.
weaknesses: Motorola from the Revengers was able to defeat and capture Low Key off-screen. Due to his age, Low Key was unable to keep up with the poses that artists required him to achieve in homages to Jack Kirby.

lowell lovett.origin: Lowell Lovett was the alias taken by a member of a Skrull community which inhabited Dungston, Iowa under the disguise of regular humans. Lowell settled in Dungston after taking part in a war many years in the past. He worked as a mechanic at the Lovett & Sons service station. Lowell and the other members of his community grew suspicious of the appearance of the former Avenger Hawkeye in Dungston, even though neither he nor his allies, Tilde Johnson and Red Wolf, had any clue of the town's secret. They were simply passing through and needed a place to rest while their van was fixed by Wheels Wolinski. Lowell confronted Hawkeye, much to the archer's surprise, but he was interrupted by the arrival of a Skrull-hunting unit. Lowell was shot in the head and killed, reverting to his Skrull form.

lu wei.name: Lu Wei
lu wei.origin: A farmer working in rural China, Lu Wei moved to the city with her young son Sam Chung in an attempt to find a better life. A few years later, they entered the United States of America illegally. Once in New York, Lu had a daughter named Hannah Chung. Lu didn't divulge the identity of her father. When both Sam and Hannah were adults, Lu was lured by rising crimelord Tenfingers into his Church of the Sheltering Hands. She became one of his top lieutenants, and integrated his Eights, a group of select individuals who had a portion of Tenfingers' power bestowed on them. She vouched for Sam to be accepted into the Church, without knowing that Sam was also a vigilante codenamed Blindspot who worked against Tenfingers. After The Hand attacked targeted the Church in revenge for Tenfingers having stolen power from them, Lu was confronted by her son, who also revealed his secret identity, in an attempt to convince her to leave the Church. During the final battle, she killed her two teammates on the Eights and disappeared after severing her ties with her son. Lu returned to Sam's life shortly afterwards once she learned he had had his eyes gouged out by the maniac criminal Muse. Lu took Sam away and brought him to a temple of the Hand in China, where she sold her soul to the Beast in exchange for restoring Sam's sight. Wei then had Sam lure his former mentor Daredevil to the temple in order to have his soul take Lu Wei's place in the bargain. When Sam had a change of heart and decided to help Daredevil after leaving him to the Beast, Wei reluctantly assisted her son in fighting the Beast. She was caught by the demon and swallowed whole.

Gustav managed to save himself and the newborn, but Lua perished in the flames.

luc.name: Luc
luc.origin: Luc was a down-on-his-luck French mutant who had lost his job and been to prison at least once. Desperate, he sought to earn a living in the criminal underworld, and so visited a Czech mutant named Viktor, who was claimed to be able to get mutants any criminal job. However, Viktor was in fact a slave trader who sold mutants on the black market for scientific experimentation, and he knocked Luc out and erased his memories with his psionic third eye. Luc awoke in a cell with three young mutant women, the Czech sisters Markita and Vanessa and the American Tanya, all with their memories erased. Once Vanessa and Markita touched each other, however, their power to merge into one body activated and their memories returned. They were then knocked out by an arriving Viktor, who explained that a customer intended to buy Tanya. However, the customer was in fact the shapeshifting mutant spy Mystique, who had come to destroy Viktor's organization. Viktor grappled with Luc and Mystique, before Tanya's memories returned, and she activated her powers and defeated Viktor, whom Mystique then killed. Mystique enlisted Luc and Tanya's help in taking down one of Viktor's main customers, the DermaFree Corporation. Luc and Tanya fought off the guards at DermaFree's secret lab, while Mystique infiltrated it. Luc and Tanya held off the guards long enough for Mystique to accomplish her mission, but were ultimately defeated. Fortunately for them, Mystique had returned in the guise of an officer, and sent the other guards on a wild goose chase, saving the lives of the two mutants.
powers: Luc had the ability to shift his skin into a metallic form at will. His mutant form was outfitted with razor-sharp spikes that could be used as a defense against opponents.

luc lemay.name: Luc Lemay
luc lemay.origin: ===Wendigo!=== Luc became a Wendigo at some unknown point in the past. He attacked a film crew that was shooting a documentary about Wendigos and tried to mate with an actor wearing a Wendigo suit but before he had a chance to kill the last two survivors he was attacked by Wolverine, who cut off his left arm, forcing him to flee. ===Heart of the Monster=== Amadeus Cho accidentally summoned the Wendigo to Las Vegas along Arm'Cheddon, Bi-Beast, Fin Fang Foom, and Umar. Bi-Beast and Wendigo used the Wishing Well to become 30 feet tall and attack the Hulk, who used the Wendigo's low intelligence to make him believe that Bi-Beast was also his enemy. Hulk then proceded to launch them both into space, where they crashed against Arm'Cheddon's spaceship. They were later transported to the Dark Dimension by Umar where they were kept as prisoners but they managed to escape when Tyrannus invaded the Dark Dimension.
weaknesses: Diminished Intellect: As a Wendigo Luc is not really intelligent and can be easily tricked.

luca aldine.name: Luca Aldine
luca aldine.origin: left|200px|thumb|Luca as a young delinquent ===Origin=== Luca lived with his two parents in North Carolina until the birth of his sister Ruth Aldine, a mutant with no eyes. Their father left only a week after her birth. Their mother was forced to work too long to support her family, and Ruth was left with Luca who hated her for being a mutant and causing all his problems. Luca both physically and emotionally abused her before falling into theft and drug abuse. Luca was eventually sent to rehab where he fell under the tutelage of a religiously bigoted minister. Luca's abuse of Ruth and her mother escalated until one day he came to kill Ruth with a chainsaw. Ruth's mother died protecting her from Luca. Luca was quickly apprehended and sentenced to death. After this tragedy, Ruth was raised by her aunt in Prospect Plains, New Jersey. The time with her aunt was the happiest six years in her life, and she learned to control and master her power. Due to some sense of family solidarity, Ruth attended the execution of her brother, where he manifested astral projection and stole half of Ruth's power leaving her mind incomplete and broken. thumb|left|Luca kills his mother Luca's psyche survived and inhabited only his eyes. Armed with half of Blindfold's psychic powers, Luca thirsted for revenge. ===Prodigal=== Luca made contact with Legion in China and set in motion the events to bring him back to his sister by sending Legion to "rescue" two young mutants, Karasu and Sojobo. Luca also manipulated the X-Men into believing Legion was planning to harm the children. After a brief battle and chase, Legion escaped and the X-Men took custody of the twins. However, during this time Luca had taken possession of Sojobo. Once inside the Jean Grey School, Luca found Blindfold and attempted to kill her. Fortunately Legion arrived just in the nick of time and stopped him; Lucas was still confident that he was safe from the schizophrenic mutant having spent hours on end setting up events to happen around the school in accordance with his predictions, all to stall and subdue him. He boasted that David was powerless to stop him from carrying out his agenda on account of his having seen all possible events and outcomes before either having even attempted their dance. Soon after realizing that he couldn't predict Legion half as well as he thought, possibly due to Haller's mental madness, his then host's sister Karasu got between them, only for her to be swept aside by the rogue persona driven Legion. While initially frightened by this new appearance, Luca soon quickly gathered his composure and his facade, posing as Sojobo to coax the X-Men into subduing Legion. This plan almost worked until the point Blindfold came in and destroyed his possessed corpse, causing his eyes to flee. For the time being Luca went around the world keeping a close eye on the vagrant scion of his prophesied mutant genocide, entertaining his bigoted hatred by vandalizing various areas the nomad he had been stalking visited with religious persecution based massacres vented towards mutants and mutant supporters while leaving ominous graffiti around or close to his handiwork dubbed: "the X-beast will eat itself". After having stated his hateful design for the time being, the disembodied eyes of Luca eventually spied his proposed vision coming to light on live television while dining in a cafe. Seeing as things seemed to be coming to a nuclear head, he rushed there as fast as he could, cobbling together a makeshift mechanical body composed of technical publication equipment from a camera crew. As he prepared to deal the killing blow to his sister in order to let his preordained genocide come to pass, he learned too late that it was all a hopped-up ruse set to trap him by none other than the quarry he'd been viewing from a distance for months. But when his captor's mind had collapsed due to the intervention of Cyclops' X-Men team, the stasis field he was trapped in collapsed and was absorbed by the Fiend/Xavier shade, which was lying in wait to possess him. Luca finally met his end at the hands of Legion when he blew apart his possessed consciousness.

lucas.name: Lucas
lucas.species: Human with latent Inhuman lineage activated by the Terrigen BombCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids
lucas.origin: Lucas was a NuHuman who was found by Hydra after the spreading of Terrigen Mist across the globe. After Lucas emerged from his cocoon, Hydra examined his blood and discovered within it a toxin capable of sterilizing human beings. Horrified and elated, they raced to devise an antidote in order to use the boy's blood in their plan to sterilize all the humans across the world (with the exception of Hydra agents, who would be given the antidote) by spreading it through bombs that would be launched into the atmosphere, where they would detonate. Lucas was having his blood drained by a machine in a new Hydra basement in Ecuador when the new Captain America Sam Wilson and his partner Nomad arrived to neutralize it. They thought him to be a prisoner of Hydra and took him out of the machine, trying to escape from the base through an elevator afterwards. However, it ultimately led them to the presence of Baron Zemo and the other members of the Hydra High Sect. While Nomad stayed behind to fight Zemo and the others, Cap took Lucas with him to another place and discovered the elevator had somehow teleported them to Bagalia, a sovereign island nation ruled by criminals. It was then that Lucas revealed to him he was an agent of Hydra and shot him. While an injured Captain America fled, Lucas returned to Zemo. After all the High Sect members took the Infinite Elevator (an elevator capable of teleporting to anywhere in the world), Lucas watched as Zemo revealed his plans to a beaten and chained up Nomad, who had his throat cut by Zemo afterwards. Later, Zemo and his operatives went on with their plan. After neutralizing the bombs in Castle Hydra and India, Cap went to Hydra's Florida base to intercept a ship equipped with a pod containing fleas full of Lucas' blood, but, despite taking the pilot down, the ship still took off as Lucas was unwilling to let him thwart their plan and piloted it himself. Lucas released the fleas and ticks infected with his blood from the pod, but they were not able to infect anyone as Cap used his telepathic link with birds to make them eat the bugs. The birds also caused huge damages to the ship and it was about to crash when Cap, who had defeated Zemo with the help of Nomad (who had survived Zemo's attempted murder), showed up to save him. Afterwards, Lucas was taken by Cap to Paris, where Cap was going to confront Baron Blood, who drank a lot of Lucas' blood and was going to self-detonate in the atmosphere, thus serving as Hydra's contingency plan to spread Lucas' blood across the globe. Lucas was then left handcuffed to a light pole. Lucas was later found and captured by Misty Knight, who had been helping Captain America to neutralize Hydra's bombs all over the world.
powers: Blood: Lucas's blood contains a toxin capable of sterilizing humans.

fields.history: Lucas was a NuHuman who was found by Hydra after the spreading of Terrigen Mist across the globe. After Lucas emerged from his cocoon, Hydra examined his blood and discovered within it a toxin capable of sterilizing human beings. Horrified and elated, they raced to devise an antidote in order to use the boy's blood in their plan to sterilize all the humans across the world (with the exception of Hydra agents, who would be given the antidote) by spreading it through bombs that would be launched into the atmosphere, where they would detonate. Lucas was having his blood drained by a machine in a new Hydra basement in Ecuador when the new Captain America Sam Wilson and his partner Nomad arrived to neutralize it. They thought him to be a prisoner of Hydra and took him out of the machine, trying to escape from the base through an elevator afterwards. However, it ultimately led them to the presence of Baron Zemo and the other members of the Hydra High Sect. While Nomad stayed behind to fight Zemo and the others, Cap took Lucas with him to another place and discovered the elevator had somehow teleported them to Bagalia, a sovereign island nation ruled by criminals. It was then that Lucas revealed to him he was an agent of Hydra and shot him. While an injured Captain America fled, Lucas returned to Zemo. After all the High Sect members took the Infinite Elevator (an elevator capable of teleporting to anywhere in the world), Lucas watched as Zemo revealed his plans to a beaten and chained up Nomad, who had his throat cut by Zemo afterwards. lucas caswell.name: Lucas Caswell
lucas caswell.origin: Lucas Caswell was hired by Banker Wells to rob the ranchers and set their homes ablaze in order to claim their ranches through the mortgages. This plot was eventually discovered by the Texas Kid who happened to be at the location of the arsonists latest attack but was unable to save the life of rancher Benito Thompson. Learning that all the properties attacked where paid for by mortgages loaned out by Wells, the Texas Kid stole the loot taken by the raiders and attempted to trick Wells into implicating himself by asking C.E.Humboldt, one of the other mortgagor targeted by gang of Wells, to toss a false note into Placer City bank with half of the stolen loot. Sure enough, Wells went to check on his men to see what they were up to. The Texas Kid clashed with them, keeping them busy long enough for the sheriff to come and arrest them all.
powers: None, base-line human.

lucas collier.name: Lucas Collier
lucas collier.origin: Lucas Collier was a resident of New Beulah, Montana who survived a near-death experience and woke up deathly afraid of angels. He was kept under the watch of the nurses at New Beulah Hospital and was rescued by Ghost Rider. While on the run from the machine gun-toting nurses, he related the story of his brief death prior to his resuscitation. He arrived to find the Gates of Heaven closed because Heaven was under siege by Zadkiel. Zadkiel had enslaved all the newly-arriving souls and those in purgatory to build his siege engines. Anyone who refused had their soul torn asunder, a fate worse than spending eternity in Hell. He then tried to convince Johnny to avoid Zadkiel because his power and that of the other Ghost Riders could break the deadlock of the war. As he finished his story, he was shot and wounded by the nurses. They made their escape but found themselves on Highway 18 where they had to contend with the ghosts who haunt the site of their former murder. After escaping Highway 18, Ghost Rider crashed through a bus and lost Collier. Collier fled from the nurses and ran into Danny Ketch, who was revealed to also be a servant of Zadkiel and who wanted to talk with Lucas about his future. After that talk, Lucas Collier grabbed a gun and told Ghost Rider that he can't beat Zadkiel. He thought they would be safer in Hell, and thus killed himself to make sure he was sent there.

lucas evans.name: Lucas Evans
lucas evans.origin: ===Origins=== In 1924, Luke Evans joined the United States Army. After years of service, he eventually earned the rank of Captain. Unfortunately, he was demoted to sergeant after standing up for one of his men. Driven into a deep depression, Luke almost ended his life by suicide, but found new purpose in life after Japan attacked Pearl Harbor and the United States joined World War II. ===Super Soldier=== Luke took charge of an all Black platoon in Camp Cathcart, Mississippi. After losing the secrets of the Super-Soldier Serum with the death of Dr. Erskine, the United States Army still wanted to produce more Super-Soldiers like Steve Rogers. Col. Walker Price and Dr. Wilfred Nagel forcibly recruited Sarge and 299 other Black soldiers to serve as test subjects to recreate the Super-Soldier Serum. To keep the operation secret, families were sent letters informing them of the soldiers' deaths. left|thumb|200px|The Black Super-Soldiers Of the 300 Black soldiers, only a handful of men survived the gruesome process. These survivors became a convert black ops team. After a few missions, only Sarge, Maurice Canfield, and Isaiah Bradley remained. While waiting in Sintra, Portugal for the arrival of Captain America, Maurice discovered the truth about his parents' death. Enraged by the information, coupled with PTSD and an exaggerated thyroid gland, Maurice was led into a confrontation resulting in his death, the death of Sgt. Evans, and the severe injury of Isaiah and Pvt. Merritt.
abilities: Military Training: Luke was trained in unarmed combat by the US Army.

lucas jackson.name: Lucas Jackson
lucas jackson.origin: Lucas Jackson was the son of Sarah Anne Jackson. Born in Rock Hollow, Arkansas, he was a mutant with a monstrous form, and his appearance prompted Sarah Anne's husband to abandon them. Lucas was born with the ability to sense the emotions of others and enhance them. Fearing that the people in town would persecute her son, Sarah Anne kept the boy hidden. However, the townspeople eventually learned about Lucas, and since the town was faltering due to a recent economic recession, used the boy as a scapegoat. When they attempted to burn down Sarah Anne's home, they were interrupted by the arrival of the Fantastic Four's Thing who arrived in the region via the Inhumans dog Lockjaw. The Thing and the local sheriff tried to defend Sarah Anne and her family, but the group accidentally slew Sarah Anne when a thrown rock fatally struck her in the head. Lucas used his powers to quiet the angry mob and send them home without further violence. After burying his mother, Lucas agreed to return with Lockjaw to the Inhuman's Great Refuge on the Moon.

lucia page.name: Lucia Page
lucia page.origin: Lucia was born to the woman who would become the Leper Queen. During the fifth month of pregnancy, that woman felt her fetus was infected after she had seen a mutant. She manifested her mutant pyrokinetic powers at an unusually early age: At a few months old, she could create small sparks at first, the scale of her powers quickly escalated until she caused a massive conflagration that burned the family house down at the age of two. Lucia was killed in that fire, and her mother permanently disfigured. From that day on, the woman swore vengeance on all mutants for what they had done to her family.
powers: Lucia could manifest bursts of fire through unknown means, ranging in size from small sparks to huge conflagrations. She possibly carried no inherent immunity to her own flames.

lucian deviant.name: Lucian (Deviant)
lucian deviant.species: Hybrid of unstable Armechadon Deviant and genetically stable Deviant of TebbelCategory:Armechadon/Tebbel Deviant Hybrids
lucian deviant.origin: ===Origins=== Lucian was the fourth child born to Tantalus and Nirvana on Armechadon, but while his siblings had been, to various degrees, genetically perfect, Lucian was born with a birthmark, signifying his father's Black Legacy. Nirvana killed herself the evening Tantalus was to journey to earth, to prevent her from giving birth to any more monsters. Tantalus brought Lucian with him to earth, where he was exiled by the Celestials. Tantalus treated Lucian with contempt because of his birthmark, and had low regard for his abilities. Lucian was sent alongside Schizo and Bristle to escort Pandara back to Lyonesse, but along the way, had to fight through the rebel leader Blackwulf, Thunderstrike, Stellaris, and Code: BLUE. When Code: BLUE rallied against them, Lucian was convinced by Schizo and Bristle to retreat, abandoning Pandara. Lucian trained against his brother Pelops, and again lost to him in battle, which was no great surprise to Tantalus. Tantalus sent Lucian to lead the Peacekeepers in recovering the human scientist Dr. Caitlin Maddox, a genetic researcher who might be able to stabilize the Deviant genetic code. However, Lucian's mission was interrupted by the arrival of the Underground Legion, of which resulted in him fighting their leader Blackwulf. In the course of battle, Lucian suspected he was battling his own brother, Pelops. Ultimately, the Underground escaped with Dr. Maddox. ===Blackwulf=== Later, Pelops returned to Lyonesse and revealed himself to Lucian as Blackwulf. He dared Lucian to kill him, but Lucian couldn't. However, Tantalus overheard this treachery and slew Pelops himself, hoping that this would teach Lucian a valuable lesson. Instead, Lucian vowed to destroy his father, and adopted the name of Blackwulf for himself. Blackwulf attempted to inform the Peacekeepers of what had happened to Pelops, but they dismissed his accusations against Tantalus. Lucian therefore sought out the Underground Legion, and presented himself to them as their new member. They distrusted Lucian immediately, but he proved his worth to them as they fought the Peacekeepers over the bodies of two dead Skrulls at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base. However, the Peacekeepers escaped with one of the bodies, and the Underground was forced to flee from the arriving soldiers. Taking to the air in a stealth fighter, they were shot down by the villain Scorch. Wildwind was seemingly killed in the crash. Blackwulf battled Scorch in the wreckage of the fighter and was able to match his power, but he and the Underground were forced to surrender when reinforcements arrived for Scorch. They were soon imprisoned at the base. Blackwulf was set free by Dr. Maddox and the Prime Skrull, and while the others departed, he went back to retrieve Wildwind's body. Scorch was waiting for him, and the two fought over her body, with Blackwulf ultimately triumphing. To his surprise, the rest of the Underground waited for him to return, and they set back to their base. Blackwulf joined the Underground and Giant-Man in following Sparrow to Ottsville, Pennsylvania, where she had disappeared on assignment. They found that the people of Ottsville had been taken over by living circuitry devised by Ultron, and that Sparrow herself was under Ultron's control. Mammoth broke Ultron's control over Sparrow by telling her that Lucian had killed Pelops, and how he was now the new Blackwulf. Sparrow attacked Blackwulf, but was brought to her senses. The Underground and Giant-Man were unable to capture Ultron, but Blackwulf defeated Sentry #459, and Giant-Man mended some of Ultron's damage by making the people of Ottsville believe that they had been restored to full humanity. Blackwulf returned to the mansion with the Underground, and Sparrow started another fight with him, still holding him responsible for Pelops' death. Blackwulf had an opportunity to kill her with his Black Legacy, and she welcomed it. At this, Blackwulf stood down, disgusted by her lack of emotion. He told her how Pelops' last words had been that he loved her-- but Lucian didn't think she deserved such love. He then left the Underground. ===Tracking the Demolisher=== Lucian learned from S.H.I.E.L.D. databases held by the Underground Legion that the Luther Manning, formerly known as Deathlok and going then as the Demolisher, a cyborg from an alternate reality, came from a world in which Pelops was still alive and Tantalus had converted to the side of good. Lucian was now determined to seek Deathlok out so he could learn more about his reality. Just as Lucian caught up with Deathlok in a series of underground tunnels where he was assisting homeless people against the Sewer King alongside Daredevil, Lucian put aside his questions to aid the homeless from bombs planted down there by Walter Jenkins. Lucian saved Deathlok from being slain by one of the bombs, which annoyed the cyborg. Finally able to ask him his questions, Lucian was told by Manning that nothing he could tell Lucian woul
weapons: The Shadowlance, which lets him channel his hatred into blasts of concussive force.

Because he can be gone for days at a time, the cats have become very independent and are sometimes skittish around guests. However, when they first met Rogue, they were very affectionate with her. When Coven Akkaba magically destroyed the Lighthouse, Captain Britain magically protected the cats from harm while keeping the gateway to Otherworld open with her Starlight Sword.

lucile serr.name: Lucile Serr
lucile serr.origin: Lucile was a woman that was kidnapped by Aunt Serr and mutated into a creature with the intent of her being the bride of Serr's son, Karl Serr. While working towards the goal of conquering the world with Karl as its new king Serr had brainwashed Lucile into believing that she was her niece. Lucile aided the Sub-Mariner after Karl struck him with lightning and tried to talk Aunt Serr into sparing him. But after Serr attempted to use the Dissipator on him, the same machine she had used on Lucile and the other mutated People of Starkburg Lucile tried getting through Serr's influence of Namor which she did so successfully. Namor fought Karl but ultimately it was Lucile who defeated Namor when Serr used her influence to transform Lucile and attack him. Leaving Namor for dead Lucile continued to serve Aunt Serr while under her influence until Namor returned to her mansion. While confronting the three Lucile was able to snap out of the influence long enough to toss Namor from the mansion just as it exploded due to the destruction of the Dissipator by the People. Lucile, Aunt Serr, Karl, and the rest of the People were seemingly killed in the explosion leaving Namor as the sol survivor.

lucius farnsworth.name: Lucius Farnsworth
lucius farnsworth.origin: ===Honey Producer=== Lucius Farnsworth was a mutant, gifted since birth with various abilities, among them telepathy, mind control, and size alteration. Thanks to those abilities, he was able to communicate with bees and could approach them without protective gear such as netting. With his bees, Farnsworth was the most successful honey producer in his state. As he didn't trust banks, he kept a fortune in his house. One of Farnsworth's employees, Eric, spied on him to learn the combination to his safe and broke into his house, only to be surprised by Farnsworth who had woken up for a midnight snack. After Eric aimed a gun at Farnsworth and shot at him, Farnsworth used his powers to control Eric and take his gun. He then forced Eric to go to the apiaries, while revealing his status as a mutant. Once there, Farnsworth shrunk the two of them down and forced Eric into the hive where he let his bees hunt him. Stopping the bees at the moment they were going to sting him, Farnsworth made Eric swear he would not try to rob or injure him, and they were both returned to their original size. Farnsworth claimed the whole event was an illusion that had created when Eric pointed a gun at him, but afterwards Eric let drop a tiny metal object, what he thought to be his still miniaturized gun, leaving him in doubt forever. ===Retired Millionaire=== A millionaire, Farnsworth later retired in the Farnsworth Estate. There, he witnessed the beauty of his garden, taken care by the gardener George. Farnsworth encouraged George to open his own landscaping business, offering him to back him financially. George kept refusing, content to be in his position. One day, one of his plants mutated due to exposure to radioactive dust (originating from a neighboring atomic experimentation facility), becoming a sentient Weed, able to talk and control other living creatures. Before Lucius could remove it, his body was paralyzed by the Weed, who revealed to him its plan of controlling mankind before putting him into a deep sleep, as it intended to rest as well in order to increase its powers. During its sleep, it was destroyed by George, unaware of its powers. Farnsworth was immediately awoken, and secretly thankful that George hadn't taken his offer, leading to his role in saving humanity.

lucius hall.name: Lucius Hall
lucius hall.origin: thumb|left|Lucius Hall Professor Lucius Hall was a school teacher who taught near Camp Lehigh in the 1940's. He eventually decided to take up a career in crime. To this end he would develop the identity of the "Camera Fiend", wearing a disguise to obscure his identity he would use a specially rigged camera that would fire poisoned darts that would kill his intended targets upon contact. Hall became obsessed with obtaining royal jewels being shipped in from Britain. As the Fiend he would break into the Maritime Commissioner where he would murder the men on duty and steal the information he needed. However, before he could escape he would be attacked by Captain America and his sidekick Bucky, unaware that Bucky was one of his students. When the authorities would end up arriving on the scene the Camera Fiend would flee into the night. The following day, as Professor Hall, Lucius would agree to Bucky's suggestion that they go and watch as the royal jewels are offloaded from a ship later that day. Neither of them aware of the fact that in doing so would suit both of their ends. At docks, Professor Hall would slip away to change into the Camera Fiend, kill the British ambassador and make an attempt on the jewels. However, Captain America and Bucky would intervene again and send the Camera Fiend fleeing. Deducing Bucky's double identity, he would take advantage of Bucky's boast that he could get Captain America's picture. That night, the Camera Fiend would sneak into Camp Lehigh and replace Bucky's camera with one that was rigged to fire a poison dart. Captain America would manage to prevent himself from being fatally poisoned just in time. Cap would attempt to feign being dead to try and lure the Camera Fiend into getting close enough to be captured, however the Fiend would not fall for it and leave a mocking note instead. The next day, Bucky would bring Captain America into his class to make up for the lack of picture. Hall would attempt to snap a photo of Captain America, hoping to catch the hero off guard and kill him with one of his darts. However, by this time, Cap had deduced the Fiend's true identity and once more avoid a poison needle. Captain America, with the aid of Bucky and members of the Sentinels of Liberty youth group would capture Hall and turn him over to the authorities.
abilities: Hall was a trained teacher, specializing in the education of young adults.
weapons: The Camera Fiend was armed with a camera that was specially rigged to fire a needle that was coated with a lethal poison. The cameras flash would cover the delivery method of his poison.

lucius issac.origin: As Blade, Makoto and Razor infiltrated Siquijor Island, Lucius Issac issued Frost a warning against his activities. He went to Deacon Frost's hideout in the Philippines and gave him a letter from the High Council demanding that he cease his experiments. Frost threw the letter away and Lucius said he wanted to keep an eye on him. Deacon said he was working on a race of vampires. Frost told him that the blood of Blade was the key to everything. Blade had arrived at the location and Deacon had to stop his experiments. Lucius watched as Frost defeated Blade and drained his blood before escaping. Lucius was disgusted when he saw the Mananangal and later on the beach he saw that Blade killed the monster.

lucius marius.name: Lucius Marius
lucius marius.origin: According to Carnage, Lucius Marius was a Roman soldier who was the sole survivor of a battle to conquer a city. Delirious with bloodlust, Lucius stormed into the city demanding to be given food, drink, and women. Furious when his demands were ignored, Lucius rampaged through the city until he encountered a strange woman holding a baby. thumb|left|Lucius' human form Lucius snatched the infant away from the woman intending to kill it, but to his shock it was revealed to be a symbiote glamoured by the woman, who was a sorceress. As the symbiote engulfed him, Lucius demanded to know what it was, the sorceress telling him it was effectively their child. Lucius took the sorceress as his lover and lieutenant, and they exited the city. While Lucius claimed a helmet to accentuate his new symbiote, the sorceress used her dark magic to reanimate the surrounding corpses into an undead horde for Lucius to command, leading an undead army to rampage and pillage across Europe.
weapons: As a soldier, Lucius wielded a double-bladed sickle-like weapon. After bonding to the symbiote, he became able to use its fangs, claws, and tendrils in combat.

lucius p gregory.name: Lucius P. Gregory
lucius p gregory.origin: Lucius P. Gregory was the richest home-builder in the state at some point in the 19th Century. He had made his fortune by being a greedy, unscrupulous man. He would use inferior materials and unskilled labour when building his houses and would then charge high prices for the sub-par results. When it came to building his own home, however, Gregory spared no expense, building a lavish mansion for himself. Shortly after its completion though, it was apparent something was wrong. It became very clear that the house was haunted, prompting Gregory to learn as much as he could about the supernatural in an attempt to drive the spirit out. After several failed attempts and barely escaping the house unharmed, Gregory was furious. Used to getting what he wanted and unwilling to accept defeat, Gregory decided to spend his entire fortune to move the house to a location that was not haunted. He never suspected that the it was the house itself that was the problem, having been built out of the trees from a haunted forest.

lucky silva.name: Lucky Silva
lucky silva.species: Human with hereditary animal shape-shifting abilities
lucky silva.origin: Lucky Silva and his sister Good lived in a suburb in Detroit, Michigan with their mother. Both possessed the inherited ability to turn into animals, a two-tailed fox and a wolf, respectively. One night, their neighbourhood was attacked by several supervillains, secretly hired by councilman Dick Snerd to get rid of high-risk neighbourhood's. A portion of the Silvas' house was damaged by Firebrand, severely injuring Lucky. He was subsequently hospitalized. Once he had partially recovered, Lucky escaped from his hospital room and reunited with Good to leave Detroit. Even though Good left with her brother, she ditched him in order to assist the Great Lakes Avengers fight Doctor Nod.
powers: Therianthropy: Like his sister Good, Lucky possesses the ability to transform into animals
in his case, a two-tailed pink werefox. When he was hospitalized unconscious, he suffered from partial transformations.

lucrezia borgia.name: Lucrezia Borgia
lucrezia borgia.origin: Borgia was a 15th or 16th century Italian noblewoman born into a mad family seeking religious and political power through any means necessary, even if that meant poisoning rivals. thumb|left After her death, she became part of the souls trapped in Mephisto's Hell-realm. Chosen by Satannish with three other damned souls to be part of his Lethal Legion, Lucrezia was transformed into Cyana. With her new body, Borgia gained the power to exude poisons from both her long, claw-like fingernails, which were now capable of killing with just a scratch, and her lips, meaning that her kiss was also deadly. With these newfound powers, she battled against the U.S. Agent, Hawkeye, the Scarlet Witch, and the other West Coast Avengers. At the end of a battle between Satannish and Mephisto over the possession of the stolen souls, Lucrezia and her fellow Legionnaires were first de-powered, then destroyed. Sometime later, her preserved head was retrieved in Italy by a group of mercenaries hired by Borgia Omega and subsequently seen as part of the necro-cyborg's frame and hive mind.

lucy.origin: left|thumb|As Sung Li Sung Li was the descendant of a supernatural high priestess who used her powers to imprison the souls of her people in an urn. Developing powers herself, she became the curator of a mystical library. The library held all of the knowledge on Earth, but any one who goes inside becomes a faceless slave, helping maintain the library and its contents. Wanting to destroy the urn before the souls before they could be released, she sought out the superhero Wolverine. The she unintentionally fell in love with him and they moved in together in an apartment in San Francisco. She faked her kidnapping by ninjas and sent a letter to local , tricking him into helping Logan. One of her assistants met the two at her apartment and sent them to her library. In he Librarian identity, she told them of her ancestor's story and her hidden powers. She gave Logan a talisman that could destroy the urn where to find it before sending them back. After they succeeded, Sung emerged from the back room. After returning home, Logan saw Sung putting away the Librarian suit. Realizing she was using him the entire time, he left her and San Francisco despite her claims that she did loved him.

lucy barton.name: Lucy Barton
lucy barton.origin: Lucy Barton was the girlfriend of Arthur Parks, the Living Laser, until she broke up with him to get engaged to another man. She had been a friend of Janet van Dyne when they were debutantes together, and recognized Janet when she saw her with the rest of the Avengers as the Wasp. Lucy Barton met van Dyne when the Avengers came to the bank of her fiance's father to investigate the crime scene of a robbery. She told her she was frightened by her ex-boyfriend Arthur Parks, who got angry when they broke up and accused her of choosing her fiance because of his money. Parks became the supervillain Living Laser and was infatuated with van Dyne. He kidnapped van Dyne but was defeated by the Avengers and taken for psychiatric custody. Van Dyne reported this to Barton. Later, it was revealed that Lucy had indeed married her fiance and was now Lucy Shapiro.

lucy bauer.origin: Lucy Bauer and her husband Joseph were working for the Momentum Alternative Energy Laboratories when they discovered the ancient tome known as the Darkhold. They sought to use its knowledge to create new technology, but were betrayed by Eli Morrow, who beat Joseph into a coma and forced Lucy and her co-workers into the Quantum Particle Generator, which forced them to become stuck between dimensions. left|thumb|Before the transformation Morrow then trapped Lucy and the others into one of the Quantum Batteries each, where they experienced no passage of time into the box-like looking battery was opened. Years later, Lucy's battery was stolen by Chen and his gang, and after they opened it, Lucy was able to escape and infected those around her, causing them to see horrific nightmares. She then departed her prison to find and free her former co-workers and locate the Darkhold, hoping that it could help reverse their condition.

lucy cervantes.name: Lucy Cervantes
lucy cervantes.species: Human, Lucy grew up idolizing Iron Man as a young girl and began working on her own armor as a child.
lucy cervantes.origin: Growing up, Lucy Cervantes idolized Iron Man. As a child, she wrote him letters and began building her own suit of technological armor, starting when she was six years old. Years later, under the name Gadget, she signed up with the Initiative. After successfully completing training at Camp Hammond, Gadget was assigned to the Nebraska team with Paragon and Captain Ultra. While checking an alarm, Gadget and Paragon were attacked by Graviton. Gadget was crushed to the size of a billiard ball, instantly killing her. Although initially Graviton was suspected, it turned out that Paragon was her killer. Before her death, Gadget had been going through case files and discovered a large amount of missing person cases in the area. These missing persons were apparently being used as test subjects, and Lucy was killed in order to cover this up.
powers: Gadget used an armor of her own design. Its abilities other than illumination and infrared scanning are unknown.

lucy keough.name: Lucy Keough
lucy keough.origin: Lucy Keough was a pirate captain in the 16th century, and an ancestor of Wanda Maximoff. In 1587, while engaged in battle with a Spanish ship, she was partially possessed by the displaced spirit of her descendant. As a result of Wanda's influence over her personality, she found herself unexpectedly sparing her enemy's lives. Later that year, while visiting her two infant children in her home in Normandy, she was attacked by one of the Spaniards she had spared, who felt humiliated to have been defeated by a woman. Wanda's mind awoke completely, and helped Lucy defeat the Spaniards with her magic. The two women discussed their situation, and Lucy swore to help her descendant return to her proper time. Lucy consulted with a seer to learn how to return Wanda's mind, and learned she needed the power of the Stones of Merlin to achieve that. She and her crew raided an English castle to acquire the stones, and was able to complete the spell that returned Wanda to her own time and body. Lucy then announced to her crew that she was retiring from piracy to raise her children and enjoy a life as a gentlewoman. Her crew would go on to find a new captain – the fearsome Blackbeard.
abilities: Lucy Keough was a skilled tactician, and one of the finest swordswomen of her time. While possessed by Wanda Maximoff, she was also capable of casting Hex Bolts.

lucy nguyen.name: Lucy Nguyen
lucy nguyen.origin: Originally a runaway that attempted to pickpocket Natasha Romanoff, Lucy agreed to a trade by Natasha for her wallet and no police in exchange for Lucy's stolen purses; unaware of the interior tracer. Lucy was then forcefully applied super serum by Apogee's subordinates before Black Widow rescued her. At The Web, she opened up of how her volatile electric powers frightern her. Wanting to end Apogee's further exploitations, she gave Natasha a lead with the name "Voss". After the capture and interrogation of Gumby, an Olio member, Lucy watched as his powers lost cohesion and killed him; realizing her powers will do the same without a cure. Depressed, Natasha changed her focus having her identify Aldrich Lux Voss and deducing his shell company where Apogee could be operating within; Lucy wanted to accompany but was told to stay behind. However, Lucy followed and used her powers to defibrillate Yelena back alive, given a spare parachute to exfiltrate Yelena from the scene; admiring Natasha's prowess base jumping a skyscraper. Regrouping at the Web, Lucy helped Yelena into the infirmary and stayed with Olio defector Craig as he concocted a cure for Apogee's power serum. Donning a sleeveless suit to help fight the Olio, Lucy convinces Craig to accompany her with syringe cures, which later aid Natasha in defeating a hyper charged Apogee. With one cure left and her powers beginning to overload, Natasha gives Lucy the cure saving her life, but her powers can no longer deactivate in her arms. Addressing the cured Olio, Lucy shows them the cost of Apogee's powers and tells them to just go home, before heading home herself with her new superhero friends.
powers: Lucy can generate electricity from her body, outputting it or ejecting it through her hands and arms.

lucy robinson.name: Lucy Robinson
lucy robinson.origin: Lucy Robinson was once a seemingly ordinary housewife, by her own admission without any other real goals in life or possessing any extensive education. She was also a mutant with psionic powers of persuasion that she could unknowingly use to make people to carry out even her slightest suggestion as if it was a direct order. This phenomenon evidently caused some strife with her husband, and she was easily persuaded to abandon her family by Tobias Messenger, a powerful but untrained telepathic mutant who believed a war between humans and mutants was inevitable. Unsure of all Messenger was asking of her, Lucy joined Messenger's Promise organization, and as a result spent a decade in suspended animation. In her absence, her older son grew to adulthood, only to die while serving with the military in Vietnam. The Promise would reawaken every ten years, spending a week to reconnoiter the current state of the world, as well as to search for new additions to their band. During this time, Lucy began to realize what she had turned her back on in pursuit of Messenger's dreams, and started to hate him, plotting her revenge. Thirty years after joining the Promise, but barely a month to her, Lucy gained her chance when the Promise awoke in modern times and, in pursuing new members, learned of the X-Men. During this time awake, the Promise initially only sought out Lorna Dane, but later included her boyfriend Havok when he came looking for her, Messenger and his followers having practically kidnapped her with their combined telepathy. Lucy used her power to make the Promise include another X-Man, Angel, which some members wrote off as her being attracted to him before returning to hibernation. However, Lucy had reprogrammed her and Angel's stasis tubes to reawaken them after only a few minutes. Rather than free his colleagues, Lucy again used her power to make Angel fly her away from Messenger's secret base so that she could return to her family. Having traced her family's movements since she abandoned them, Lucy knew that her younger son Michael was now living in a suburb of Philadelphia, and had Angel fly her there. It is not the family reunion she'd hoped for her, as her son was now older than she was, and had grown up without her after she'd mysteriously disappeared. As he showed signs of being a mutant-hater, and unwilling to use her own powers to force him to take her back, Lucy soon left with Angel. Returning to the Promise's headquarters, they are mentally contacted by Professor Xavier, who is able to read from Lucy's subconscious details of the tubes' inner workings, and has Angel speed up the internal chronometers of Havok and Lorna's tubes. Unfortunately, having been placed in hibernation without his power-regulating suit on, Havok's built-up energy soon reached critical levels, and Angel and Lucy barely have time to take cover before an explosion devastated the Promise's headquarters. In the aftermath, they found Havok alive and conscious, and were able to retrieve his costume, but also found where Lorna and the other Promise members' tubes had been damaged. Using her power, Lucy had Havok follow the Professor's instructions to head for New York to help in a fight against an Atlantean invasion, the result of manipulation by Magneto, while she and Angel stayed behind to help Lorna and the others. Angel soon after flew off in search of the other X-Men, whom Messenger had trapped in an underground chamber, leaving Lucy alone. Able to stabilize the other tubes and rewire their chronometers to go faster as well, Lucy managed to safely revive Lorna and her fellow Promise members. However, she also used the opportunity to get revenge on Messenger, telling him that he would be better off dead, which caused his body to “switch off” thanks to her power. Afterwards, the Promise decided to disband, feeling that Messenger's approach was ineffective and that they needed to stay and take action in how society reacted to them, rather than hiding and waiting for the world to end. Also leaving, Lucy first stopped to make mocking remarks to Messenger's corpse, insinuating her intention to use her powers to redirect civilization for the better. Her current whereabouts and activities, if any, are unknown.
powers: Lucy was a mutant with telepathic powers. She had the ability to make others susceptible to her suggestions. If they were aware of her power, however, it became easier for them to resist.

Having traced her family's movements since she abandoned them, Lucy knew that her younger son Michael was now living in a suburb of Philadelphia, and had Angel fly her there. It is not the family reunion she'd hoped for her, as her son was now older than she was, and had grown up without her after she'd mysteriously disappeared. As he showed signs of being a mutant-hater, and unwilling to use her own powers to force him to take her back, Lucy soon left with Angel. Returning to the Promise's headquarters, they are mentally contacted by Professor Xavier, who is able to read from Lucy's subconscious details of the tubes' inner workings, and has Angel speed up the internal chronometers of Havok and Lorna's tubes. Unfortunately, having been placed in hibernation without his power-regulating suit on, Havok's built-up energy soon reached critical levels, and Angel and Lucy barely have time to take cover before an explosion devastated the Promise's headquarters. In the aftermath, they found Havok alive and conscious, and were able to retrieve his costume, but also found where Lorna and the other Promise members' tubes had been damaged. Using her power, Lucy had Havok follow the Professor's instructions to head for New York to help in a fight against an Atlantean invasion, the result of manipulation by Magneto, while she and Angel stayed behind to help Lorna and the others. Angel soon after flew off in search of the other X-Men, whom Messenger had trapped in an underground chamber, leaving Lucy alone. Able to stabilize the other tubes and rewire their chronometers to go faster as well, Lucy managed to safely revive Lorna and her fellow Promise members. However, she also used the opportunity to get revenge on Messenger, telling him that he would be better off dead, which caused his body to “switch off” thanks to her power. Afterwards, the Promise decided to disband, feeling that Messenger's approach was ineffective and that they needed to stay and take action in how society reacted to them, rather than hiding and waiting for the world to end. Also leaving, Lucy first stopped to make mocking remarks to Messenger's corpse, insinuating her intention to use her powers to redirect civilization for the better. Her current whereabouts and activities, if any, are unknown.
powers: Lucy was a mutant with telepathic powers. She had the ability to make others susceptible to her suggestions. If they were aware of her power, however, it became easier for them to resist.

lucy ryker.name: Lucy Ryker
lucy ryker.species: Human Mutate, due to gamma radiation
lucy ryker.origin: Lucy Ryker was the wife of John Ryker, who contracted terminal cancer. In an effort to cure her, Ryker had Lucy injected with some of the Hulk's gamma-irradiated blood. Although it was temporarily successful in removing her cancer, the treatment soon caused Lucy to mutate uncontrollably into a disfigured gamma being. Ryker isolated his wife and dedicated himself to hunting the Hulk, hoping to use the green goliath in experiments to one day fully restore Lucy. During the fight between the Hulk and Flux, General Ross decided to find out what Ryker was hiding in a secret room, but was denied entry by the guard posted there. Ross was then joined by Doc Samson who knocked out the guard, so they could see what's inside. Much to their horror, they find out a deformed creature inside a holding tank, was none other than Lucy Ryker. Taking her hostage, Ross revealed to Lucy all of the horrific experiments with gamma research her husband had been conducting. This prompted Lucy to depart from Ryker, coldly telling him that she didn't ask to be cured at the risk of innocent lives. Lucy died alone after her long battle with cancer, refusing to see Ryker, even at the very end.
weaknesses: She is dying of cancer.

lucy stone.name: Lucy Stone
lucy stone.origin: Lucy was a wealthy woman who owned the biggest ranch in the Midwest with the finest herd of cattle; unknown to others, the herd were vampire cattle which drained the blood of other cattle in order to keep hers the best. She found Ricky Stone beaten nearly to death and abandoned on the side of the railroad tracks. Lucy nursed him to health and Ricky married her in an attempt to inherit her money. He used her belief in the occult to pretend vampires were attacking the ranch in attempt to kill her via a weak heart. She passed out and the doctor was brought in to treat her. Ricky set out to kill a cow and stage a vampire attack, then Lucy found him and he told her there were vampires all around the ranch. Lucy believed that he had uncovered her secret and Ricky was killed by her vampire cattle.

ludi.name: Ludi
ludi.origin: A cult worshipping Ludi kidnapped Lenore Wilkins and prepared her to be his new bride. The ceremony was interrupted by Murdoch Adams, who scared Ludi away with the loud noise of his pistol. Adams rushed to a church to perform the "rite of exorcismorum". Ludi busted in and killed the priest. Adams attacked Ludi with an old sledgehammer, which did nothing until the rotted end broke and the head flew off and hit the church bell. The loud peal hurt Ludi. Noticing this, Adams kept ringing the bell until Ludi fled through a portal of blackness. The pealing bell shattered the portal, banishing Ludi from returning to Earth. Later, empowered by the Dweller-in-Darkness to fight Dr. Strange, Ludi had Strange beaten until Clea threw the Ebony Blade at Ludi. The sword weakened Ludi, and Dr. Strange was able to use it to defeat the demon. Ludi fled through a magic portal.
powers: (Class 10) Immune to Disease : He does not age Wings to provide flight : He can change his density so as not to be damaged by normal weapons and certain forms of magic. He can tear out a person's soul.
weaknesses: Loud and vibrations. . Though empowered by the Dweller-in-Darkness, Ludi was not vulnerable to blinding .

ludlow grimes.name: Ludlow Grimes
ludlow grimes.origin: Ludlow Grimes was happy with his life as a farmer, working by man and horsepower alone, and living in a small house with his wife, Amy, and his two sons by her, Jeff and Willy. Twenty-nine years after a mysterious meteorite had crashed to Earth, Ludlow discovered its second half. His new powers suddenly became apparent when he inadvertently shattered the wall of his house. His wife and kids saw him as some sort of inhuman monster, and Amy immediately insisted that he leave them forever. Ludlow went to see a priest, who branded him as an agent of the Devil. Soon after, his former friends were hunting for him, seeking to exorcise his demons...with a touch of the torch. Ludlow spent lonely months hiding out in caves and other secluded areas, until he learned of the existence of a man with powers like his, inside the Smithville City limits. However, instead of being demonized, this man was a hero. Ludlow, his mind rattled by his recent trials, decided that he would destroy and replace the Smithville Thunderbolt, so that he, too, would be respected and admired. Eventually, Ludlow did track down the Smithville Thunderbolt in his apartment, but he was fought off by Spider-Man, who had also tracked him down. Ludlow fled when the police arrived. However, he found the Thunderbolt again when he was trying to trick another reporter, Roxanne DeWinter, into thinking he'd saved her life so she wouldn't expose his true identity. After a brief scuffle with Spidey, Ludlow managed to get his hands on Fred Hopkins, the now powerless Thunderbolt. However, when he saw how frail and terrified Hopkins was, he came to his senses, and realized that the frightened man was just like him. With no harm done, Ludlow was recruited by an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., who offered to help find the cause of his powers, see if they could be removed, and maybe even reunite him with his family.
powers: speed, agility, and endurance

ludvig prinn.name: Ludvig Prinn
ludvig prinn.origin: Ludvig Prinn was an alchemist and a necromancer who studied the black arts, supposedly had invisible companions and demons as servants, and conducted evil researches and experiments. By the 16th century, he claimed to have lived for 500 years. His researches and experiments eventually caused him to be dragged off by the witch-hunters. While awaiting the stake in a dungeon, he wrote the evil book De Vermis Mysteriis, full of evil knowledge, containing potent spells and enchantments, the "blasphemous lost lore of eons past, of the gods who walked the Earth", information on "Father Yig", "Dark Han" and "serpent-bearded Byatis", and a mean to summon "strange creatures and stranger gods", and " magical servants from the stars" such as the Shambler from the Stars.
powers: Allegedly, he had lived for 500 years, presumably thanks to his alchemy and/or .

ludwig van beethoven.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
ludwig van beethoven.origin: Ludwig van Beethoven was a German composer and pianist. Beethoven remains one of the most admired composers in history. The time travelling Marcus Immortus manipulated the time stream bringing famous historical figures to serve him and Carol Danvers. He brought Shakespeare to write her a sonnet, he brought Beethoven to perform an original prelude in her honor and Marie Antonette who clothed her in the finest satins and silks. The immortal Tiresias was a close friend of Beethoven and they had an interesting relationship as Tiresias was blind and Beethoven was deaf (late in his life). This led to an interesting confrontation with the Mayor of Vienna, a story Tiresias still tells to this day.

ludwig von baum.name: Ludwig von Baum
ludwig von baum.origin: Ludwig von Baum was a colonel and a top Nazi strategist working for the German army. Ludwig was sent by "Uncle Adolf" to Italy by passing through Switzerland. For Ludwig's safety, Captain Wilhelm Hauser, Leutnant Strasser and their men guarded him on the way. Unknownst to them, Sgt. Fury and his Howling Commandos raided the train and defeated Baum's men, which caused Ludwig and Hauser to flee to the roof of the train, but were quickly confronted by Eric Koenig, who was an old friend of Hauser. Afer a short fight, Hauser tried to escape and was killed by a tunnel. At the end of the station, Ludwig, pretending to be a doctor, was handed over to the Swiss authorities, and could now be considered as a prisoner of war.

They misinterpreted Howard's words, "Get Down!" as meaning to give up, leave if your problems became too much. The WACkies were funded by billionaire Scrounge McDrake, allowing them to gain great political power. However, Howard mysteriously returned and denounced their ideals. Rev. Gander plotted their former messiah's downfall. Dr. Ludwig von Cluck was sent by Rev. Gander to expose the human; Beverly Switzler as a robot, but really planned to tear her clothes off so that the Duckworldians would be appalled that Howard had had a sexual relationship with a Human.

However, the Troubador has already arrived and playing the song "Death in Venice", both Jim and Luella recognize the Troubador as their old colleague David Larnum, a shock as they believed that David had drowned years ago. Larnum explains that he survived the shipwreck they believed claimed his life and lived on a deserted island for a number of years before finding his way back to the mainland. There he had learned that they took his song and made it famous and decided to take revenge against those who stole his work. Jim and Luella try to reason with him, explaining they published the song in his memory believing him dead. When the Troubador refuses to listen Namor and Namora come crashing through the window and easily knock out the Troubador and his gang. Several days later, Namor and Namora rush to shore once more to see Jim and Luella put on a performance of "Death in Venice".

lugh.name: Lugh
lugh.species: Tuatha de Danaan with Fomorian lineageCategory:Fomorian/Tuatha de Danaan Hybrids
lugh.origin: ===Origins=== Lugh was a prominent deity in the Celtic pantheon, revered as both a sun god and a warrior of the Tuatha de Danaan. His parentage is a subject of varying accounts; some traditions identify him as the son of Cian, a Tuatha god, while others claim he was the offspring of the Dagda, another deity within the same pantheon. His mother, Ethniu, was a Fomorian, a race often depicted as adversaries of the Tuatha. Lugh was one of triplets born to Ethniu. According to legend, Ethniu's father, Balor, the Fomorian ruler, was forewarned by his wife, Cethlann, that a grandson would bring about his demise. In an attempt to prevent this prophecy, Balor sought to drown the infants, but Lugh alone survived. ===Myth=== left|thumb|Lugh and wife Cerridwen Lugh was said to have been married to Cerridwen, a goddess associated with wisdom, witchcraft, fertility, and magic. If the Dagda is considered his father, Lugh would have been the younger half-brother of Bodb Derg, the god of war, and Rhiannon, the horse goddess, through the Dagda's union with the Morrigan. Lugh was often depicted wielding the Spear of Lugh, a mystical weapon that required immersion in a cauldron of blood when not in use to quell its insatiable thirst for destruction. ===Battle with the Fomorians=== Around 1896 BCE, the Tuatha de Danaan migrated from the Otherworld to Earth, where they waged war on the Fir Bolg. The Tuatha emerged victorious in the First Battle of Mag Tuired, though their king, Nuada, sustained severe injuries that rendered him unfit to rule. He was succeeded by Bres, a half-Tuatha, half-Fomorian ruler whose tyrannical reign lasted seven years before he was deposed. Enraged, Bres rallied the Fomorians to wage war against the Tuatha. Despite his Fomorian lineage, Lugh's loyalties lied with his Tuatha kin. In the ensuing conflict, during the Second Battle of Mag Tuired, Lugh fulfilled the prophecy of Balor's demise by grievously wounding and blinding his grandfather, leading to the Tuatha's triumph. Lugh also captured Bres but spared his life on the condition that Bres teach the Celts the art of agriculture. Following their defeat, the Fomorians were driven back to the Dark Realm of the Otherworld. ===Progeny=== Lugh fathered a son, Sétanta, with the mortal druidess Deichtine, sister of Conchobar mac Nessa, the King of Ulster. The demigod, later known as Cúchulainn, the Hound of Culann, was born in Mag Muirthemne, located in present-day County Louth, Ireland. Upon his death, Cúchulainn was deified and inherited his father's Spear of Lugh, which he renamed "Slaughter." However, the spear did not remain in his possession indefinitely; in 150 BCE, an Irish warrior maiden retrieved it to slay the Morrigan's host at the time, subsequently becoming the goddess's new vessel. ===Celt Worship=== thumb|Worship of the sun god Lugh was venerated across the western Celtic world, with numerous sacred sites dedicated to his honor. The Druids, the spiritual leaders of ancient Britain and Gaul, held him in high regard, often worshipping the sun god Hu, a likely corruption of his name, as their father figure and Cerridwen as their mother. Rituals in his honor frequently involved the sacrifice of cattle, and it was believed that Lugh granted magical abilities to the Druids who worshipped him, empowering them to perform potent spells and rituals. He was also feared for his ability to summon storms as retribution against those who defied sacred laws or offended him. ===Christianization=== The Roman conquest of Britain marked the beginning of the decline in the worship of Lugh and other Celtic deities. As Christianity spread, many pagan sites were either repurposed or destroyed. Churches were often erected over locations once considered sacred to Lugh and Cerridwen. In one notable instance, a church built on a site of ancient mystical power was said to house stone gargoyles that gained sentience, a testament to the lingering influence of the old gods. ===Modern Era=== In modern times, Morgan Le Fay summoned corrupted versions of Lugh, Morrigan, Cernunnos, and Taranis from the Netherworld to attack Arizona. Doctor Strange identified these entities as ancient demons and Fomorians and banished them back to the Dark Realm. ====Gargoyle Incident==== In recent times, a figure known as Derwyddon, a Druid preserved beneath the ocean for centuries, re-emerged into the modern world. Rescued by sea sprites, he awoke to find that the Druidic faith had largely faded into obscurity. Disillusioned and embittered, particularly toward Christianity, Derwyddon encountered a church constructed on a site of ancient mystic power. Noticing the stone gargoyles, he used his magic to animate them, transforming their stone forms into living beings. However, the gargoyles, driven by vengeance, turned against him. In a final act of defiance, Derwyddon sought refuge within the church and used his remaining strength to encircle the building with sacred oaks. As he collapsed, he lame

fields.history: ===Origins=== Lugh was a prominent deity in the Celtic pantheon, revered as both a sun god and a warrior of the Tuatha de Danaan. His parentage is a subject of varying accounts; some traditions identify him as the son of Cian, a Tuatha god, while others claim he was the offspring of the Dagda, another deity within the same pantheon. His mother, Ethniu, was a Fomorian, a race often depicted as adversaries of the Tuatha. Lugh was one of triplets born to Ethniu. According to legend, Ethniu's father, Balor, the Fomorian ruler, was forewarned by his wife, Cethlann, that a grandson would bring about his demise. In an attempt to prevent this prophecy, Balor sought to drown the infants, but Lugh alone survived. ===Myth=== left|thumb|Lugh and wife Cerridwen Lugh was said to have been married to Cerridwen, a goddess associated with wisdom, witchcraft, fertility, and magic. If the Dagda is considered his father, Lugh would have been the younger half-brother of Bodb Derg, the god of war, and Rhiannon, the horse goddess, through the Dagda's union with the Morrigan. Lugh was often depicted wielding the Spear of Lugh, a mystical weapon that required immersion in a cauldron of blood when not in use to quell its insatiable thirst for destruction. ===Battle with the Fomorians=== Around 1896 BCE, the Tuatha de Danaan migrated from the Otherworld to Earth, where they waged war on the Fir Bolg. The Tuatha emerged victorious in the First Battle of Mag Tuired, though their king, Nuada, sustained severe injuries that rendered him unfit to rule. He was succeeded by Bres, a half-Tuatha, half-Fomorian ruler whose tyrannical reign lasted seven years before he was deposed. Enraged, Bres rallied the Fomorians to wage war against the Tuatha. Despite his Fomorian lineage, Lugh's loyalties lied with his Tuatha kin. In the ensuing conflict, during the Second Battle of Mag Tuired, Lugh fulfilled the prophecy of Balor's demise by grievously wounding and blinding his grandfather, leading to the Tuatha's triumph. Lugh also captured Bres but spared his life on the condition that Bres teach the Celts the art of agriculture. Following their defeat, the Fomorians were driven back to the Dark Realm of the Otherworld. ===Progeny=== Lugh fathered a son, Sétanta, with the mortal druidess Deichtine, sister of Conchobar mac Nessa, the King of Ulster. The demigod, later known as Cúchulainn, the Hound of Culann, was born in Mag Muirthemne, located in present-day County Louth, Ireland. Upon his death, Cúchulainn was deified and inherited his father's Spear of Lugh, which he renamed "Slaughter." However, the spear did not remain in his possession indefinitely; in 150 BCE, an Irish warrior maiden retrieved it to slay the Morrigan's host at the time, subsequently becoming the goddess's new vessel. ===Celt Worship=== thumb|Worship of the sun god Lugh was venerated across the western Celtic world, with numerous sacred sites dedicated to his honor. The Druids, the spiritual leaders of ancient Britain and Gaul, held him in high regard, often worshipping the sun god Hu, a likely corruption of his name, as their father figure and Cerridwen as their mother. Rituals in his honor frequently involved the sacrifice of cattle, and it was believed that Lugh granted magical abilities to the Druids who worshipped him, empowering them to perform potent spells and rituals. He was also feared for his ability to summon storms as retribution against those who defied sacred laws or offended him. ===Christianization=== The Roman conquest of Britain marked the beginning of the decline in the worship of Lugh and other Celtic deities. As Christianity spread, many pagan sites were either repurposed or destroyed. Churches were often erected over locations once considered sacred to Lugh and Cerridwen. In one notable instance, a church built on a site of ancient mystical power was said to house stone gargoyles that gained sentience, a testament to the lingering influence of the old gods. ===Modern Era=== In modern times, Morgan Le Fay summoned corrupted versions of Lugh, Morrigan, Cernunnos, and Taranis from the Netherworld to attack Arizona. Doctor Strange identified these entities as ancient demons and Fomorians and banished them back to the Dark Realm. ====Gargoyle Incident==== In recent times, a figure known as Derwyddon, a Druid preserved beneath the ocean for centuries, re-emerged into the modern world. Rescued by sea sprites, he awoke to find that the Druidic faith had largely faded into obscurity. Disillusioned and embittered, particularly toward Christianity, Derwyddon encountered a church constructed on a site of ancient mystic power. Noticing the stone gargoyles, he used his magic to animate them, transforming their stone forms into living beings. However, the gargoyles, driven by vengeance, turned against him. In a final act of defiance, Derwyddon sought refuge within the church and used his remaining strength to encircle the building with sacred oaks. As he collapsed, he lame
weapons: Formerly wielded the powerful Spear of Lugh, which was given to his son.
fields.notes: Lugh was stated to be the brother of Bodb Derg, who is son to the Dagda and Morrigan. However, Lugh's son Cúchulain is stated to have the Dagda and Ethniu as his paternal grandparents, with Iarbonel and Balor as paternal grandparents. Lugh is consequently half-brother to Bodb Derg. Rhiannon was identified as the daughter of the Dagda and Morrigan, making her either a full or half-sister to Lugh, depending on the account of his parentage. It is also stated that Lugh was the son of Cian instead of the Dagda, and had two brothers (though they were slain in their youths) in the Fomor's profile in , but was also listed as the Dagda son in the same issue, in the Dagda's profile. Hu was identified as the Celtic sun god, as was Lugh. Hu is likely a corruption of Lugh’s name, suggesting they represent the same entity.
